evidence.note: Trailing slash makes the audience differ from the SP entity ID. Audience comparison is an exact string match.

output.fix: Make the audience and the SP entity ID identical. Preferably, change the IdP's SP configuration (the audience or entity ID field) to exactly https://sp.example.com/saml/metadata, with no trailing slash. If the SP's registered entity ID really does include the trailing slash, update the SP's configured entity ID and its published metadata to match, and re-register it with the IdP. Keep the audience check as an exact match, and don't add normalization or wildcard matching. Keep signature validation, the time-window check and clock skew of 5 minutes or less as they are.
